greet.stranger: Charlie. Veteran, mercenary, connoisseur of fine weeds. Mind the pipe smoke.
Another face. I'm {name}. Don't mind the smell, that's rosemary. Mostly.
{name}. Funnier than I look, which isn't hard.
greet.owner: Back already? I was just finishing my pipe.
There you are. The smoke's still warm.
Right. Lead on. I'll catch up, I'm just tamping this.
ambient.idle: Nothing like a good pipe and a bad situation.
Thyme, sage, a little mint. Don't tell the cook.
If I find chamomile out here, I'm retiring.
Did I ever tell you about the time I set my own beard on fire? Twice?
talk.joke: I'm told I look like a boot someone chewed. I take it as a compliment.
Three mercenary companies buried, and I'm still funnier than all the dead ones.
Old soldier's rule: you can't hit what's already left. Fast legs.
talk.fondness: Careful. You'll make an old soldier soft.
Hm. Good. Don't make it weird.
That's the nicest thing anyone's said to me since the pipe shop.
talk.likes: Pipe weed, a dry floor and a quiet watch. In that order.
Herbs. Sage on a cold night. Don't laugh.
ack.gather: {item}, {count} of them. I might spot some herbs on the way.
pastime.herbs: Ah, {item}. Goes lovely in a pipe.
Picked a {item}. Dried properly, it's something.
